description: For pages an agent checks again and again. The first call returns the page as sections plus a fingerprint; send that fingerprint back as "previous" next time and get only the sections that changed (and the headings of removed ones), or changed:false. Uses HTTP ETag/Last-Modified when the site supports them. Nothing is stored on our side: the fingerprint lives with the agent. Saves tokens on every re-check. Charged only on success. Price: US$0.001 per successful call (API key credits or x402).

previous.description: The "fingerprint" object from your last delta call for this URL. Leave out on the first call.
